_schema_note: permanent = manual-reset-only trackers, never auto-cleared. repeating = cadence-based tasks (daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly/seasonal/biseasonal), auto-reset per cadence. id only needs to be unique WITHIN its cadence (or within 'permanent') — storage key is auto-built as '<cadence-prefix><id>'. priority: 'high' (default) or 'low' — high-priority items render first within a tab, then sorted by id.
